layman_headline: Fear is gripping the crypto market — patience is the smartest move right now.
layman_explanation: The overall mood in crypto is at 'Extreme Fear' (25 out of 100) and getting worse by the day. While Bitcoin itself is holding up okay with a small bounce today, altcoins are in rough shape — most are deep below their all-time highs and showing bearish chart structures. The candidates on the watchlist either just pumped too hard (BTW up 58% in a week), are in freefall with no chart data to confirm a bottom (LDO down 23%), or are in clear downtrends (ZRO, MON). None present a clean swing trade setup with a favorable risk-reward ratio.
layman_action: Do nothing right now. Keep your cash ready. When fear is this extreme and worsening, prices can still drop further before finding a real bottom. Wait for signs that the panic is fading (Fear & Greed climbing back above 30) and for a candidate to show a clear technical reversal pattern before committing money.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated rules: Rule 3 states that when Fear & Greed is at or below 25, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and HOLD is the safest call. Rule 7 notes BTC tends to drift down another 1-4% in these conditions, though the sample is small. The RSI signal — our most reliable indicator at 71% win rate — is oversold on ZRO (29.76), which would normally be interesting, but the chart bias is -0.70 (bearish), price is below all MAs, and the risk/reward to nearest support/resistance is only 1.31x — well below the 2.0x minimum for a quality setup. BTC dominance at 56.5% further argues against alt exposure. High BTC dominance during extreme fear historically means alts underperform. No funding rate data is available to confirm any contrarian squeeze thesis. I am choosing capital preservation over a marginal setup.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed at 25 and worsening — market could cascade further if CLARITY Act fails or macro deteriorates
BTC dominance at 56.5% means capital is fleeing alts — any alt entry faces structural headwinds
CLARITY Act legislation odds at 27% could trigger another selloff if it officially dies
watch_list: ZRO RSI approaching deep oversold — if it drops to 25 or below with a bullish reversal candle near $0.70 support, that could be a high-quality mean-reversion entry
Fear & Greed Index — watch for a turn back above 30 which would signal the worst of the panic is passing
ADA momentum — up 23.9% in 7 days against a fearful market, monitor if this strength persists or reverses as a gauge of alt appetite
market_context: Crypto is in an extreme fear environment (25/100, worsening trend) with BTC dominance elevated at 56.5%, signaling risk-off rotation out of altcoins. Bitcoin is relatively stable (+2.2% today) but altcoin candidates show weak structures, and regulatory uncertainty around the CLARITY Act adds a macro overhang.
context_banner: Extreme Fear at 25 with worsening trend and no clean alt setups — disciplined patience beats marginal trades.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 25 (Extreme Fear), down from 28 yesterday with week average of 27 — Rule 3 triggers a HOLD recommendation at this level due to genuinely ambiguous short-term outlook.
ZRO RSI at 29.76 is oversold (our most reliable signal at 71% win rate), but the bearish chart structure and poor 1.31x risk/reward prevent acting on it — the setup quality is insufficient.
CLARITY Act odds sinking to 27% removes a key potential bullish catalyst for the broader crypto market and adds regulatory uncertainty.

No volume breakout signals detected across any candidate — lack of conviction buying during extreme fear suggests the bottom is not yet confirmed.
